description.narrative: The objective of the Second Dushanbe Water Supply Project for Tajikistan is to improve water utility performance and water supply services in selected areas of Dushanbe. There are four components to the project, the first component being metering and demand management. The component will finance consumption metering and bulk metering of water, for increased revenue, reduced wastage, and better tracking of losses, including: i) supply and installation of 76,500 residential meters (i.e. approximately 46 percent of Dushanbe Vodokanal (DVK) users; and installation of 1,500 apartment building master meters in selected areas of the city; ii) rehabilitation of 1,500 apartment building service connections; iii) supply and installation of bulk flow meters at water production facilities; iv) supply and installation of a Network Information System (NIS); v) communication strategy and public awareness campaigns to promote metering and demand management; and vi) installation of Supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) system. The second component is the water quality improvement. The components will support system upgrades for improved quality of water, including network cleaning. The third component is the institutional strengthening and capacity building. The component will finance activities to build institutional capacity and improve utility performance of DVK, which includes: carrying out an assessment of DVK's organizational and capacity-building needs; and installation of modern accounting, billing and water revenue collection systems. Finally, the fourth component is the implementation support.
The project development objective is to improve water utility performance and water supply services in selected areas of Dushanbe.

comment.narrative: <p>This indicator was intended to measure the adequacy of cash generated by DVK and its ability to pay its liabilities. The indicator value is calculated based on the financial data presented in audited financial statements for the fiscal year(FY2019). As a result of increase in the water tariff that was enforced in Dushanbe, this has improved leading DVK to have some surplus after covering its expenses. This target is exceeded. </p>

title.narrative: Improvement of water turbidity at the outlet of SAM

comment.narrative: <p>By project closing 99% of the samples demonstrated a turbidity that is less than the standard maximum allowed concentration (MAC) of 2mg/l, and this target is fully achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Yearly energy consumption (only water supply services)

comment.narrative: <p>This indicator intends to measure the reduction on energy consumption by DVK for the production of water. With a major reeducation on the total energy consumed by DVK (kWh) which currently stands at 17.4 m kWh less than the target, reaching more than 110% of the target, this indicator is overachieved.</p>

title.narrative: Piped household water connections that are benefiting from rehabilitation works undertaken by the project

comment.narrative: <p>The number of meters installed under the Project has increased substantially and this coupled with the rehabilitation work under the project, has allowed more Households to benefit from improved services. The target is exceeded.</p>

title.narrative: Improvement of water turbidity at the outlet of NAP

comment.narrative: <p>By the project closing, 99% of the samples demonstrated a turbidity that is less than the maximum allowed concentration of 2 mg/l, and this target is fully achieved.</p>

<p>Turbidity is the presence of suspended particles in the water and the standard is set for 2mg/l. According to the lab tests for May-December 2019, 98 % of the samples complied with turbidity level ranging from 0 to 2.0 mg/l. The traget is fully achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Number of residential customer registered and billed as % of the population in Dushanbe

comment.narrative: <p>With the registration and metering of more customers, this target is achieved and exceeded.</p>

title.narrative: Per person water production in the system

comment.narrative: <p>This is a proxy indicator, dividing the daily production with population figures and initially it was high and due to high losses, all was not under use. The project helped to take loss reduction measures and energy savings, that were translated in reduction of aggregate production per person. This is a huge achievement compared to the starting basis (reaching more than 113%) for the project and the target is exceeded considering the revised target.</p>

title.narrative: Bacteriological water quality in the network

comment.narrative: <p>This indicator estimates the number of bacteria present in the water. A maximum coli form count of 3 per liter of water is considered to be safe for drinking. For the project, 99% of samples complied with the standard and the target is fully achieved.</p>

<p>Sensitivity of the test is 0,02 mg of chlorine left, after the initial application per every liter of water. DVK was taking  measurements daily and the data was compiled and accessed annually. By closing of the project, 99% of samples showed a residual chlorine below the traceable border and target is achieved fully.</p>

title.narrative: Installation and Development of Network Information System (NIS) with technical assistance

comment.narrative: <p>DVK didn't have such system during the appraisal of the project and was not in a position to manage all data relevant to the network and its operation. By the end of the project, DVK has fully completed the digitization and GIS mapping of the network that was further verified by the hydraulic modelling consultant. The target is fully achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Number of water utilities that the project is supporting

comment.narrative: <p>The project planned to support one utility and achieved that 100%, and target is fully achieved.</p>

<p>The indicator value is calculated using audited financial statements of the DVK for the fiscal year and for the purpose of this ICR the FY2018 was considered as the latest was not ready. The indicator is calculated as a total amount of accounts receivable including bad debts to revenues. While the revenues increased in the reporting period, the amount of unrecoverable debts almost stayed the same. During the preparation of this ICR, DVK was aggressively pushing to collect the remaining receivables and is likely to reach its set target on Accounts receivable target, indicating a strong likelihood to be achieved soon.  </p>
<p>The metering reached 100% of the revised target and it is Fully achieved.</p>

<p>By the close of the project, DVK has a fully computerized billing system that was not the case during appraisal. This is further supported with the necessary technical support to make it operational and target is considered as fully achieved.</p>

actual.value: Comouterized billing system is fully operational.

title.narrative: Completion of training in monitoring of energy costs and energy audit

baseline.value: DVK does no?t have the methodology for conducting the energy audit

comment.narrative: <p>DVK has conducted trainings in monitoring of energy costs and has developed a methodology for conducting energy audit. This target is fully achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Supply of modern water testing laboratory equipment to DVK

baseline.value: DVK using outdated water qulity equipment in its laboratories.

comment.narrative: <p>At appraisal DVK was using an outdated water quality testing equipment. The project supported the renovation of the water quality laboratory and equipped it with state of the art modern equipment and instruments. Target achieved.</p>

actual.value: DVK Water quliaty laboratories equiped with modern equipment.

title.narrative: Completion of the water supply masterplan

comment.narrative: <p>A water supply master plan is developed and target is considered fully achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Completion of the Tariff and Connection fee study

comment.narrative: <p>Target achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Reduction of technical water losses in the pilot area of Dushanbe

comment.narrative: <p>By the close of the project, the conceptual hydraulic simulation was at final stage and the replacement of pipes was also at an advanced stage. The contribution of these activities in reducing the loss is estimated at 3% which is an attribution to the project. Target is considered as achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Introduction of rechlorination systems in the network

comment.narrative: <p>Installation of re-chlorination system with optimum dose and location helps to achieve the required residual chlorine concentration at the end of a water network. At appraisal DVK didn't have re-chlorination system. The project supported the installation of five Re-chlorination systems and target is fully achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Reconstruction of filters at SAM treatment plant

comment.narrative: <p>Both the first and second tranche filter were completed and currently in operation. Target achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Availability of water supply services - Percentage of customers with 24h of water supply service per day

comment.narrative: <p>The final survey was conducted on winter 2020 and results indicated that, 94% of the House Holds were getting 24h of water supply service per day. This target was steadily improving, and compared to the baseline of 57% (which later was revised to 87%), this target is exceeded.</p>

title.narrative: Improved water quality (in general) - Percentage of customers, satisfied with water quality

comment.narrative: <p>The winter survey of 2020 indicates that, 92% of the House Holds are satisfied with the quality of water delivered. Howeverwith the completion of the final finishing activities especially the second phase of SAM treatment plant, this is likely to increase (to be confirmed from post completion customer survey). Compared to the starting basis for the project and considering the continued improvement during the Project's life time, there is a strong likelihood for this target to be achieved soon.  </p>
